POWER RESTORATION UPDATE
Affected Areas:
Whole of AGF1 - Mabini St. (Gonzaga-Malalosan St.) (Malalosan-Hernaez St.), Gonzaga St. (Mabini-Lacson St.) (Lacson-Gatuslao St.), Lacson St. (Gonzaga-Bacolod Business Inn), Rizal St. (Lacson-San Juan St.), Cuadra St., San Juan St. (Rizal-Burgos Ave), Gatuslao St. (Galo-Luzuriaga St.) to Luzuriaga-Araneta, Centroplex, Bacolod Central Market, BACIWA, San Sebastian Davis, Bishop’s Palace, Bay Center, San Sebastian Cathedral, DYAF – Radyo Veritas, GE Money Bank, Bacolod Business Inn, LCCB, Gaisano Grand Central (new).
Whole of AGF2 - Lacson St. (San Sebastian St. to Abad Bridge), Mabini St. (Gonzaga Substation to San Sebastian St.), San Sebastian St. (Locsin St. to Sta. Ana St.), UNOR-IS, Planta Hotel, Civil Service Commission Negros Occidental Field Office, Portion of Brgy. 39, Regency Plaza Tourist Inn, Southville Subd, Montalbo Gym., Abad Santos St., Moran St.
Whole of AGF3 - Mabini St. (from CENECO to Galo St.), Galo St. (from Mabini to Gatuslao), Locsin St. (from Galo to Rizal), Nueva St., Alisbo, PLDT, Philam Life, Cordova Road, Rizal St. (Mabini St. to Lopez-Jaena & Mabini St. to Lacson), Burgos St. (Lacson to Locsin St.), LTO, Landbank, Hall Of Justice, SSS Building, 888, portion of Brgy. 9, portion of Brgy. 11, portion of Brgy. 17., Lacson St. (1st to 20th St.) (excluding 6th St. and portion of 15th St.)
Restored at 5:44 AM
Our dedicated team has successfully restored power to the affected areas.
We sincerely thank our valued consumers for your patience and continued support throughout the restoration process.
If you are still experiencing a power outage, kindly send us your account details and contact number so we can assist you as soon as possible.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
